cosy-lesson.title: Chatting with an AI vs Chatting with a Human (A2)

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to introduce the topic and clarify key target vocabulary for the session.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Review the key vocabulary for this session below:

cosy-blockquote.p: Chatbot ≠ Human speaker – a computer program designed to simulate conversation with human users.

p.em: Example: The chatbot answered my questions instantly.

cosy-blockquote.p: Artificial ≠ Natural – made by human skill; not natural.

p.em: Example: AI uses artificial intelligence to generate text.

cosy-blockquote.p: Human ≠ Machine – a person rather than an animal or machine.

p.em: Example: Only a real human can share true feelings.

cosy-blockquote.p: Connection ≠ Isolation – a feeling of understanding and friendship between people.

p.em: Example: We formed a strong emotional connection.

cosy-blockquote.p: Advice ≠ Misdirection – guidance or recommendations offered with regard to prudent future action.

p.em: Example: My friend gave me great advice for my project.

cosy-blockquote.p: Privacy ≠ Publicity – the state of being free from public attention or intrusion.

p.em: Example: I value my privacy when talking about personal topics.

cosy-blockquote.p: Response ≠ Silence – an answer or reply in words or action.

p.em: Example: The AI gave a fast response to my question.

cosy-blockquote.p: Memory ≠ Forgetfulness – something remembered from the past; data storage capability.

p.em: Example: The computer memory holds our chat history.

cosy-blockquote.p: Available ≠ Unavailable – ready for use or at hand.

p.em: Example: AI chatbots are available 24 hours a day.

cosy-blockquote.p: Real ≠ Fake – actually existing as a thing or occurring in fact; genuine.

p.em: Example: Real friends listen with true care.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: pair/group discussion on core session themes.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs or small breakout groups, discuss the following questions:

ol.li:
Chatting with an AI chatbot gives instant responses 24/7 without waiting.
★ How often do you use AI chatbots for quick information?

An artificial tutor is ideal for practicing language basics without feeling nervous.
★ Do you prefer practicing speaking with an AI or a real partner?

Talking to AI as a digital penpal is convenient and safe.
★ Have you ever had a penpal or online friend?

AI offers quick, logical advice without making judgments.
★ Who do you turn to first when you need advice?

AI memory keeps track of your conversation details perfectly.
★ What is a special memory you shared with a close friend?
